cases.title: Identity and environment issuance
cases.requiredEvidence: Reject forged/default/foreign handles and equal descriptive fingerprints before getters; admit only exact producer/authority endpoints.

cases.title: Authority completeness
cases.requiredEvidence: Lookup NotFound, Unsupported and supported false/empty stay distinct; complete derivation, affiliation and closure never truncate.

cases.title: Typed values and precision
cases.requiredEvidence: Issued-container admission before getters; ordered empty/singleton lists and actual union member evidence; nil/no-typed-value distinct; no silent precision loss.

cases.title: Assessment and context
cases.requiredEvidence: Actual captured host context; assessment constants; complete Valid alone publishes a root; Invalid/Unsupported/cancellation never masquerade as Valid.

cases.title: Copy and provenance
cases.requiredEvidence: Copies preserve original PSVI/type/declaration facts but change current snapshot identity; strip/refusal are explicit.

cases.title: Compatible views
cases.requiredEvidence: Directional source/target/environment proof preserves original assessment; foreign view or original facts refuse.

cases.title: Lifetime and deferred work
cases.requiredEvidence: Cached Current, nested graphs, prefix/abandoned/fault/canceled consumption, reentry and close schedules; all actual leases retained/released once.

cases.title: Composite admission
cases.requiredEvidence: Default/duplicate/foreign snapshot sets reject before work; partial acquisition releases all prior leases while preserving failures; empty set only for source-free work.

cases.title: Construction and dual routing
cases.requiredEvidence: Explicit construction keeps result representation; exact no-op retention; fresh type evidence does not fabricate original PSVI. Define nested constructor dispatch and reject ambiguous legacy/native coexistence.

cases.title: Limits and diagnostics
cases.requiredEvidence: Positive explicit limits, invalid default limits, lazy per-consumption bounds, source/snapshot-bound truthful ranges, independent truncation/completeness and cancellation.

cases.title: Legacy and consumers
cases.requiredEvidence: Refresh actual source/package/unchanged-binary and provider/worker cases against the selected exact manifest; keep persisted enums/defaults/layout and old pins/history.

cases.title: All query hosts
cases.requiredEvidence: Select exact XQuery/XSLT opt-in host adapters and typed transform boundaries, then prove actual Braid typed/persistent previews. XPath-only shape is insufficient.
